description: Source code implementing device accelerator management functions within the at::accelerator namespace, including device detection, stream management, and synchronization.

methods.name: getAccelerator
methods.description: Determines the current accelerator device type based on runtime and compile-time checks, with optional checking for device availability.

methods.name: isAccelerator
methods.description: Checks if a given device type is recognized as an accelerator device.

methods.name: deviceCount
methods.description: Returns the number of available devices of the current accelerator type.

methods.name: setDeviceIndex
methods.description: Sets the current device index for the accelerator.

methods.name: getDeviceIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the current device index for the accelerator.

methods.name: setCurrentStream
methods.description: Sets the current stream for the device, ensuring device type matches.

methods.name: getCurrentStream
methods.description: Gets the current stream for a specified device index.

methods.name: exchangeDevice
methods.description: Exchanges the current device with a new device index.

methods.name: maybeExchangeDevice
methods.description: Conditionally exchanges the device if the context is initialized.

methods.name: getDeviceCapability
methods.description: Retrieves the capabilities of a specified device.
